```typescript title="TypeScript"
import { BrowserMode, createEngine, scrape } from "@xberg-io/crawlberg";
async function main() {
  const engineConfig = { browser: { mode: BrowserMode.Never }, content: { excludeSelectors: [], extractMetadata: false, keepHidden: true, preprocessingPreset: "minimal", removeForms: false, removeNavigation: false }, respectRobotsTxt: false };
  const engine = createEngine(engineConfig);
  const url = "https://example.com";
  const result = await scrape(engine, url);
  console.log(result.markdown?.content);
}
```
